answer: Earnings root before they ripen. Every epoch mints 12 POA of vote weight per key into a haven, a vesting pot paid only after audit. Each epoch the key etches a fresh signed tendril onto its vine, hash-chained on the public marble roll. One key, one vine; a shared tendril voids both keys. Lottery-drawn auditors replay 1 vine in 8 each epoch. A clone, gap, or forged link burns the whole haven, prunes the vine, benches the key one epoch. N fakes × 12 POA = 12N POA forfeited per epoch. Limit: honest keys wait to vest.
